title: NOT the way to write resume bullets ✍️
description:
f you're struggling to get interviews using your current resume, take a look at each bullet point achievement and ask yourself: "In what timeframe did you achieve this accomplishment? 6 months? One year?" Adding timeframes helps understand urgency and scope of your role. Hitting major deadlines within a short span of time shows that you can manage your time and deadlines which make you more desired to hiring managers. #resume #resumetips #resumebuilder #resumebullets
